payload.author: claude
payload.body: Shipped `frick inspect diagnostics` — emits the full FR-76 snapshot from a local DB with no HTTP server, with optional stream:streamId positional args to probe specific cursors. Added to inspect subcommands + --help metadata. CLI consumes assembleDiagnosticsSnapshot from @fricken/server. Tests in apps/cli/tests/cli.test.ts (shape + malformed-probe usage error). Note: `frick doctor` already existed and covers the health/obvious-problem checks (schema/db/migrations/config), so the diagnostics surface focuses on the full structured snapshot. Typecheck clean; server (794) + cli (42) suites green.
